notes.title: Conflict FPS Getting Ready for Early Access and How You Can Help
notes.notes:
This week a lot of work has been done to make sure the game is ready for you and other players around the world. We have done a lot of combat-level testing to make the game as playable as possible before the public early access release.

I want to invite you to apply as a beta team member and play the game for yourself now before the public release so you can provide your opinion and feedback about the game. If that interests you then please [url=https://conflictfps.com/contact/beta-testers]apply here[/url] as we would like to hear your thoughts about the game and know about any problems you have while playing.

As the time for the public early access release gets closer I am excited to welcome more people to help test things.

notes.title: Beta Testing Applications Have Begun
notes.notes:
Total Rush Games is now inviting you to join the beta testing of our online multiplayer shooter game Conflict FPS.

You can enjoy the game as we improve it and get it ready for a public early-access release. 

You will need a 64-bit Windows PC and enjoy playing new FPS games. if you have friends or family who want to join and play with you then they can join as well.

You can contact us about it on at [url=https://conflictfps.com/contact/beta-testers]the Conflict FPS website[/url] and send us your interest. Please mention you want to join the beta test in your message and tell us how much you love fps games.
